messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['Colonial Bank has just released an updated version of Webb Login with a few new minor features, and broader availability to more users.', 'New version to avoid resource spam, viruses and Spyware.', 'Barclays Bank would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Barclays Security software.', 'It om vat de installation van de noose beveiligingssoftware poor 2013.', 'You can now buy SMTP, WEBMAIL, RDP, EMAIL LEADS and get them instantly after payment though our website.', 'NatWest bank would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of NatWest Security software.', 'Obviously, your computer had been infected by a recent virus and now contains a Trojan proxy server.', 'Access to usaa.com for members who use devices with old operating systems may be affected by this Internet upgrade.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
